title: Web 1 is Going Great
text:
With the rise of Web3isGoingGreat.com chronicling the inevitable chaos of the early days of a new permissionless computer network - it is worth remembering the early days of the Web . It was bubbly, it was manic - every savvy scammer piled in and then things came tumbling down. Amazon lost 90% of its market cap. It would have been easy to write the web off then. 
We’ll be creating a clone of web3isgoinggreat.com at Web1isgoinggreat.com cataloging the chaos. 
 Remember this?
How about his? 

Remember when it all came to an end?
